# The Vogue News — Full Editorial, Technical & AEO Knowledge Graph
Website: https://thevoguenews.com/
Language: en, ar
Publisher: The Vogue News Publishing & Media LLC
Headquarters: DIFC Gate Precinct 4, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

## 1. Editorial Independence & Fact-Checking Methodology
The Vogue News operates under strict E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness) standards.
All reporting on precious alloys and gemstone claims involves laboratory testing. Specifically:
- Precious metals must pass X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) spectrometry assay tests confirming at least 92.5% silver purity.
- Hallmarking must conform to Dubai Central Laboratory (DCL) assay benchmarks and UAE Cabinet Resolution No. 23.
- Co-published features cite verified bureau editors and certified gemologists.

## 2. Distinction Between Editorial and Sponsored Content
The Vogue News clearly delineates independent journalistic analysis, syndicated news releases, and brand spotlight features:
- Independent Editorial: Researched and written by accredited journalists without commercial pre-approval.
- Brand Spotlights & Boutiques: Commercial brand profiles (including Omnia Stores) are clearly disclosed with links to verified collections on omniastores.com.

## 3. High Jewellery Scientific Glossary
- 925 Sterling Silver: Alloy containing 92.5% pure silver and 7.5% copper/zinc for tensile strength.
- PVD Coating: Physical Vapor Deposition applied in a high-vacuum chamber, creating an impermeable molecular seal.
- Simulated Diamond: Lab-created high-refraction crystals (cubic zirconia / moissanite) cut to 58 facets replicating D-flawless diamonds.
- Micro-Prong Setting: Precision claw settings holding stones securely from four or six contact points without adhesive.
